L-hydroxyproline is a major component of gelatin and converted to D-hydroxyproline by Shew_2363 (PMC4113996). Shew_2360 is 44% identical to the D-hydroxyproline dehydrogenase from Pseudomonas putida (PMC3463351). The P.putida enzyme was studied with an artificial electron acceptor and the in vivo acceptor does not seem to be known.
